tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Brand. The night sky behind the icon. Video and website backgrounds, the icon tile. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Brand. The eight dark keys in the icon. Key fills and the ring around a lit key. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: moon
tokens.usage: Brand. The speech bubble. The keypad panel in Night, title text on night in video. 15.8:1 on night.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Brand. The ninth key, the life that comes back. Fill only: the scan highlight, the primary button, the lit key. One ember thing on screen at a time. Never text, never a hairline in Day (1.7:1 on Day ground).

tokens.name: ember-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed ember button and pressed lit key. Fill only.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ember: 9.9:1. White on ember is not allowed.

tokens.name: ember-soft
tokens.usage: Selected candidate sentence behind an ember ring. Ink 12.3:1 Night, 16.1:1 Day; every proof color passes 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Night is the default theme and the brand; Day follows prefers-color-scheme: light and suits bright rooms and clinics.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the candidate list, settings sheets.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: The utterance well, inputs, segmented controls. Every text color passes 4.5:1 here.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The keypad bubble that holds the keys, as in the icon. Decorative edge; the keys carry the contrast (12.9:1 Night, 11.9:1 Day).

tokens.name: key
tokens.usage: Keypad key fill in both themes, so the keypad always looks like the icon.

tokens.name: on-key
tokens.usage: Letters and digits on a key: 12.9:1 on plum.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and chips. 4.4:1 or better on every Night surface, 3.7:1 or better on Day.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons. 13.5:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: digit codes under words, hints, timestamps. 6.4:1 or better.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text buttons. 9.9:1 Night, 5.8:1 or better Day.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 4px solid, 3px offset. Ember on Night (10.4:1), ink on Day (16.5:1).

tokens.name: proof-match
tokens.usage: A word that matches the keys pressed and is in the dictionary. Always with a check icon; chip is filled. 9.8:1 or better Night, 5.1:1 or better Day.

tokens.name: proof-new
tokens.usage: A word that matches the keys but is not in the dictionary (a name, a rare word). Always with a plus icon; chip has a dashed border. 8.2:1 Night, 5.6:1 Day or better.

tokens.name: proof-reject
tokens.usage: A model suggestion that does not match the keys. Never spoken. Always struck through with an x icon. 7.1:1 Night, 5.3:1 Day or better.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions: Clear history, Delete phrase. With an icon and a word.

families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Website hero, video title cards. One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Press nine keys. Say what you mean.
styles.usage: Section heads on the website, chapter cards in the video.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles in the app, sheet titles.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: The website hero's line on phones; title from 600px.

styles.name: utterance
styles.usage: The sentence being composed and the one about to be spoken. The largest text in the app.

styles.name: key-letters
styles.usage: Letters on a key. The letters lead; the digit is secondary.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Ninth Life runs in your browser and works offline.
styles.usage: Default body text in the app.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each word you speak matches the keys you pressed.
styles.usage: Website body, help text, settings descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, form labels. Smallest text in the app.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Website footnotes and video credits only. Never in the app.

styles.name: digits
styles.usage: Key sequences shown under words and in the proof panel.

styles.name: key-digit
styles.usage: The digit in a key's corner.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between word chips in a candidate.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between keys.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips and small cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, keypad panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between app regions: utterance, candidates, keypad.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Website section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Website and video safe margins.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Website section spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tappable thing in the app (buttons, chips, toggles). Above WCAG 2.2's 24px and the 44px platform norm, for tremor and head pointers.

tokens.name: key-min
tokens.usage: Smallest keypad key, on narrow phones.

tokens.name: key-size
tokens.usage: Default keypad key.

tokens.name: key-xl
tokens.usage: Extra-large keys setting and tablets on a mount.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, with a 3px offset.

tokens.name: scan-width
tokens.usage: Scan highlight ring width around the current row or key.

tokens.name: ring-width
tokens.usage: The pressed key's inner ember ring and the plum ring outside the scan highlight.

tokens.name: line-width
tokens.usage: Borders and rules: card edges, list rules, the chosen sentence's edge, underlines on hover.

tokens.name: target-cta
tokens.usage: Website hero buttons at every size. The app's Speak stays 80px.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Word chips, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Keys and the primary button: a quarter of the 96px key, as in the icon.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, candidate rows, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The keypad bubble and other large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles and status pills only.

tokens.name: motion-jump
tokens.usage: A highlight's colour or opacity change, linear. App and website.

tokens.name: motion-crossfade
tokens.usage: Cross-fade between pages (view transition). No-preference only.

tokens.name: motion-fade
tokens.usage: Website one-time reveal of a block.

tokens.name: motion-fade-slow
tokens.usage: Website hero arrival only: the moon glow and the ninth key's ring. Once.

tokens.name: motion-delay-arrival
tokens.usage: Delay before the ninth key's ring fades in.

tokens.name: motion-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between cards revealed together (at most 3 steps).

tokens.name: motion-autoplay-delay
tokens.usage: How long the hero demo is in view before it plays once.

tokens.name: motion-demo-step
tokens.usage: Time between key presses in the hero demo.

tokens.name: motion-reveal-distance
tokens.usage: The most a revealed block moves. Website only.

tokens.name: motion-state
tokens.usage: Website: one state change inside a drawing (a fade, with at most motion-nudge of rise).

tokens.name: motion-nudge
tokens.usage: Website: the most an arriving part of a drawing moves.

tokens.name: motion-play-lead
tokens.usage: Website: wait between a drawing reaching the play line and its first change.

tokens.name: motion-frame
tokens.usage: Website: time between steps of a played box drawing.

tokens.name: motion-frame-quick
tokens.usage: Website: time between steps of the switch and ranking drawings (the app's fastest scan step).

tokens.name: motion-sweep
tokens.usage: Website: time between steps of the proof check and the How sentence rows.

tokens.name: motion-ease-out
tokens.usage: Fades and reveals.

tokens.name: motion-ease-linear
tokens.usage: Highlights.

tokens.name: glow-ember
tokens.usage: The scan highlight and the lit key. Night glows; Day uses a plum ring because a glow vanishes on light grounds.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: The keypad panel and floating sheets only.
